about.title: About Launchkit
about.p1: Launchkit makes Next.js templates for people building a SaaS product on their own: the marketing site that sells it, and the dashboard that runs it, sharing one design system so they never look like two different products stitched together.
about.p2: Every template is real, working source code — not a page builder export, not a design file. If you can read a little React and Tailwind CSS, you can read the whole thing.
about.p3: We'd rather ship three templates that are genuinely done — documented, accessible, tested in light and dark mode, tested on a phone — than twenty that half-work. That's the whole philosophy: fewer products, each one finished.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.subtitle: Everything you need to go from purchase to a customized, deployed site.
docs.gettingStartedP1: After checkout, Paddle emails you a receipt with a download link for the template's source code as a .zip file. Unzip it into an empty folder — that's your project root.
docs.gettingStartedP2: Every template also has its own README.md in the project root with template-specific setup notes. Read that first — this page covers what's common across all Launchkit templates.
docs.installationP1: Every template needs Node.js 20.9 or later. Then, from the project folder:
docs.installationP2: Open http://localhost:3000. To build for production:
docs.customizationP1: Every template shares one pattern: colors and fonts are a handful of CSS variables in src/app/globals.css, and copy lives in plain arrays or JSX at the top of each component — there's no CMS or config layer to learn.
docs.customizationP2: Change the hex values in :root and .dark to rebrand the whole template — every button, card, and border reads from those tokens.
docs.faqP1: Common questions about purchasing and using templates are answered on the <faqLink>FAQ page</faqLink>. Questions specific to one template are answered on that template's own product page.
docs.licenseP1: Every purchase includes a Single Project license. Read the full terms, including when you need an Extended license, on the <licenseLink>License page</licenseLink>.
docs.supportP1: Check the template's README first — most customization questions are answered there. For anything else, <contactLink>contact us</contactLink> and we'll reply within two business days.

license.title: License
license.intro: Every Launchkit template purchase includes a <singleProject>Single Project license</singleProject>: a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the template's source code to build one end product, for yourself or for a single client, and to deploy that end product publicly.
license.youMay1: Modify the source code freely for that one end product.
license.youMay2: Deploy the resulting product to a live domain.
license.youMay3: Use it for a commercial project, including client work.
license.youMayNot1: Use one purchase across more than one end product.
license.youMayNot2: Resell or redistribute the template itself, modified or not.
license.youMayNot3: List the template (or a product whose primary purpose is reselling it) on another marketplace.
license.extendedTitle: Need it for more than one project?
license.extendedP: Contact us for an Extended license if you plan to use a template across multiple end products, or resell an end product built with it to unlimited customers (e.g. as a SaaS boilerplate service).
license.refundsP: If a template doesn't work for your project, contact us within 14 days of purchase for a full refund.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This site collects the minimum data needed to sell and support digital templates.
privacy.checkoutP: Payment is processed entirely by Paddle.com Market Limited, our merchant of record. We don't see or store your card details — Paddle handles payment data, tax collection, and receipts under its own privacy policy.
privacy.accountP: If you create an account, we store your name and email to identify you and show your purchase history, secured with Supabase Auth. You can request deletion of your account at any time.
privacy.contactFormP: If you use the contact form, we store your name, email, and message only to respond to your inquiry.
privacy.analyticsP: We may use privacy-respecting, cookie-free analytics to understand aggregate traffic — no cross-site tracking, no ad networks.
privacy.contactP: Questions about this policy can be sent through the <contactLink>contact page</contactLink>.

terms.title: Terms of Service

terms.purchasesP: All purchases are processed by Paddle.com Market Limited as merchant of record, and are subject to Paddle's buyer terms in addition to these terms. Template usage rights are governed by our <licenseLink>License</licenseLink>, not by this page.
terms.refundsP: Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase — see the <faqLink>FAQ</faqLink> for details.
terms.warrantyP: Templates are provided "as is," without warranty of any kind. We're not liable for damages arising from their use.
terms.changesP: We may update these terms from time to time; the date above reflects the last update.
